scripts.bfw: npm uninstall @bfw/api-sdk && npm rm @bfw/api-sdk && npm i bfw-api-sdk-1.0.0.tgz
scripts.build: npm run sync.i18n && ng build && node workbox.build.js
scripts.build.debug: npm run sync.i18n && ng build --configuration debug && node workbox.build.js
scripts.build.debug:watch: npm run sync.i18n && ng build --configuration debug --watch
scripts.build.dev: npm run sync.i18n && ng build --configuration development && node workbox.build.js
scripts.build.prod: npm run sync.i18n &&  ng build --configuration production && node workbox.build.js
scripts.debug.web: npm run sync.i18n && ng serve --watch --configuration debug --hmr --open
scripts.dev.web: npm run sync.i18n && ng serve --configuration development
scripts.prod.web: npm run sync.i18n && ng serve --configuration production
scripts.debug.ios:: npm run build.debug && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.release.ios: npm run build.prod && npx cap sync ios
scripts.syncrun.ios:: npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.debug.android: npm run build.debug && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.release.android: npm run build.prod && npx cap sync android
scripts.syncrun.android:: npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.build.apk.debug: npm run release.android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build.apk.release: npm run release.android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build.aab.release: npm run release.android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.debug.test: npm run sync.i18n && ng test --configuration debug
scripts.dev.test: npm run sync.i18n && ng test --configuration development
scripts.prod.test: npm run sync.i18n && ng test --configuration production
scripts.gpush: git add . && git commit && git push origin
scripts.brand.name: npx trapeze run tools/brand.yaml --android-project android --ios-project ios/App
scripts.brand: npm run clean.cap.web && npm run brand.name && npm run brand.assets && npx cap sync
